scripts.text: Hey did you see an ugly Goblin come by? He stole something from me!
scripts.translation: 喂，你看到一個醜陋的哥布林經過嗎？他偷了我的東西！

scripts.text: I am Morestone and I collect rare gems.
scripts.translation: 我叫莫爾斯通，專門收集稀有寶石。

scripts.text: In my travels, I was told that there were a lot of gems in Valfreyja and Nidhoggur, so I came down here.
scripts.translation: 旅行途中，我聽說瓦爾弗雷亞和尼德霍格爾有很多寶石，所以就來到這裡。

scripts.text: But here, the soil is very hard to dig into. Fortunately, my ^3131FFPickaxe^000000 never lets me down!
scripts.translation: 不過這裡的土很難挖。幸好我的^3131FF十字鎬^000000從沒讓我失望過！

scripts.text: I always carry it with me, you know?

scripts.translation: 我們就一起在這裡開工了。

scripts.text: After a few days, we finally found something!
scripts.translation: 幾天後，我們終於有了發現！

scripts.text: No, but it was worth quite a lot.
But we did not have much time to celebrate. Suddenly, a monster appeared that stole my pickaxe.
scripts.translation: 可我們還沒來得及慶祝，就突然出現一隻怪物，把我的十字鎬偷走了。

scripts.text: Is this the pickaxe that you've been looking for?
scripts.translation: 這是你一直在找的十字鎬嗎？

scripts.text: Oh, my! You've returned it to me!
My precious pickaxe, I thought I lost you forever.
scripts.translation: 我珍貴的十字鎬啊，我還以為再也找不到你了。

scripts.text: You are great! What guild are you from?
scripts.translation: 你真厲害！你是哪個公會的？

scripts.text: Could it be Gravity or Mercury?
scripts.translation: 難道是重力公會或水星公會？

scripts.text: I am a member of the ^3131FF{0}^.
Oh... That guild will receive my greatest respect.
scripts.translation: 哦...我會由衷敬重那個公會。

scripts.text: Oh! My friend, I am very grateful for your help.
scripts.translation: 哦！朋友，非常感謝你的幫助。

scripts.text: As a reward, I will tell you about a mysterious area I have discovered recently.
scripts.translation: 作為謝禮，我告訴你一個最近發現的神秘區域。

scripts.text: That's right. I found it when I was digging around here.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，我就是在這附近挖掘時發現那裡的。

scripts.text: It looks like it was made for some special purpose, but since there are no gems around there, I have no interest in it.
scripts.translation: 那裡似乎有特殊用途，不過周圍沒有寶石，所以我沒什麼興趣。

scripts.text: Instead of going there alone, I think it would be more fun to go with your friends...
scripts.translation: 比起一個人去，我覺得和朋友們一起去會更有意思...

scripts.text: If you want, I can take ^3131FFyou and your guild members^000000 to explore that area.
scripts.translation: 如果你願意，我可以帶^3131FF你和公會成員^000000去那裡探險。

scripts.text: Do you want to go there now?
Take your time, and find a place to gather your friends.
scripts.translation: 慢慢來，找個地方和朋友們集合吧。

scripts.text: If your friends visit me again later, I will guide them to that area again.
scripts.translation: 以後你的朋友再來找我，我也會帶他們去那個區域。

scripts.text: Don't forget, dwarves are grateful beings! Hahaha!
scripts.translation: 別忘了，矮人可是知恩圖報的！哈哈哈！

scripts.text: I will tell you how to find him.
Kublin wears a ridiculous golden hat, It should be easy to recognise him by that.
scripts.translation: 庫布林戴著一頂滑稽的金帽子，應該很容易認出來。

scripts.text: I, Morestone, have made an alliance with the {0} guild.
scripts.translation: 我，莫爾斯通，已經和{0}公會結盟了。

scripts.text: Would you like to go to the mysterious area?
scripts.translation: 你想去那個神秘區域嗎？

scripts.text: I hope you enjoy yourself, my friend.
If you need my assistance, just ask.
scripts.translation: 需要我幫忙的話，儘管開口。

scripts.text: Ah! Dont forget, I hate monsters! So I don't want to see them. It will be better if you ask for another favour.

一個孤獨的小丑正在表演雜耍。

scripts.text: When looked at closely, the clown is just a puppet that looks like a human.
scripts.translation: 仔細一看，這個小丑原來只是一個人形木偶。

scripts.text: The clown stops, then starts moving in accordance to your movements, noises start to emit from it's mouth.
scripts.translation: 小丑停了下來，隨後開始模仿你的動作，嘴裡還發出了聲音。

scripts.text: I am the loyal servant of Gergath, and I have finally received my orders.
scripts.translation: 我是格爾加斯忠實的僕人，終於接到了命令。

scripts.text: I am happy to hear all the laughter, but without my master's permission, I can't do anything.
scripts.translation: 聽到大家的笑聲我很開心，不過沒有主人許可，我什麼也做不了。

scripts.text: Did you get permission from Gergath?
scripts.translation: 你得到格爾加斯的許可了嗎？

scripts.text: Please give me the palm of your hand.
When is that person coming? I am very bored~!
scripts.translation: 那個人什麼時候來？我好無聊啊～！

scripts.text: ^3131FF<You're someone who can only think about nonsense everyday, you have no focus at all.>^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF<你每天只會胡思亂想，根本無法集中精神。>^000000

scripts.text: Haha, I'm just kidding. Beep beep.
Ah, you are the one my master speaks of.
scripts.translation: 啊，你就是主人提到的那個人。

scripts.text: Come, the Gergath has left a message for you.
scripts.translation: 來吧，格爾加斯給主人你留了口信。

scripts.text: It's a bit old, but it should still be legible.
scripts.translation: 雖然有點舊，應該還看得清。

scripts.text: Let's talk after I finished reading my master's message. Beep beep.
scripts.translation: 等我讀完主人的留言再聊。嗶嗶。

scripts.text: My master Gergath sincerely wishes you joy for you and your family everyday.
scripts.translation: 我的主人格爾加斯衷心祝願你和家人每天都快樂。

scripts.text: Alright, would you like to play the game Gergath has prepared for you?
scripts.translation: 那麼，你想玩格爾加斯為你準備的遊戲嗎？

scripts.text: The game prepared by my master is very unique, yet simple and fun!
scripts.translation: 主人準備的遊戲很特別，卻簡單又有趣！

scripts.text: Do you see this large and green field? Beep, beep?
scripts.translation: 你看到這片又大又綠的場地了嗎？嗶嗶？

scripts.text: I will show you the most incredible magic here.
scripts.translation: 我要在這裡為你展示最不可思議的魔法。

scripts.text: I will turn this place very white. Veeery white!
scripts.translation: 我要把這裡變得一片雪白，非常非常白！

scripts.text: The game instruction is just to find the treasure map within the time limit.
scripts.translation: 遊戲規則很簡單：在規定時間內找到藏寶圖。

scripts.text: Oh, you don't want to play?
Let me know when you are ready.
Who will find the treasure map in this white world?
scripts.translation: 誰能在這片白茫茫的世界裡找到藏寶圖？

scripts.text: Amongst all of you, who shall be the lucky one?
scripts.translation: 你們之中，誰會成為那個幸運兒呢？

scripts.text: Did you find the treasure map?
Show me what you have in your hands! Beep, beep!
scripts.translation: 讓我看看你手裡拿的是什麼！嗶嗶！

scripts.text: Ahh, what a shame, it seems like you haven't found the treasure map yet.
scripts.translation: 啊，真可惜，你好像還沒找到藏寶圖。

scripts.text: Quickly! Your time is running out! Hurry up!
scripts.translation: 快點！時間快到了！抓緊時間！

scripts.text: I don't see anything. Have you even started yet? Beep?
scripts.translation: 我什麼也沒看到。你開始找了嗎？嗶？

scripts.text: Hehe, while you're talking to me, the time is slowly ticking away~
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，你和我聊天的時候，時間可在一分一秒地流逝哦～

scripts.text: Wah, why is it like this~!!
Not enough? But this makes the game fun, no? Hahaha!
scripts.translation: 還不夠嗎？不過這樣遊戲才有趣，對吧？哈哈哈！

scripts.text: It's like trying to find a needle in a haystack!
It's hard, but if you find it, it's worth ten times the effort. Beep, beep.
scripts.translation: 雖然很難，但找到的話就會覺得一切努力都值得。嗶嗶。

scripts.text: Precious time goes by so fast.
I, Pierrot Piere, am not a heartless clown! Beep beep.
scripts.translation: 我，皮埃羅·皮埃爾，可不是無情的小丑！嗶嗶。
你的成功就是我的快樂！

scripts.text: I'll give you one more chance. How's that? Beep?

scripts.text: Let me know when you are ready.
Who will find the treasure map in this white world?

scripts.text: You managed to find a needle in a haystack!

scripts.text: You've completeled an unbelievable task, I will give you the wonderful gift master has prepared!! Ha!

scripts.text: Show me that thing you are holding, now!
scripts.translation: 快把你手裡拿的東西給我看！

scripts.text: Ahh, what a shame, it seems like you haven't found the treasure map yet.
scripts.translation: 啊，真可惜，你好像還沒找到藏寶圖。

scripts.text: Quickly! Your time is running out! Hurry up!
scripts.translation: 快點！時間快到了！抓緊時間！

scripts.text: I don't see anything. Have you even started yet? Beep?
scripts.translation: 我什麼也沒看到。你開始找了嗎？嗶？

scripts.text: Hehe, while you're talking to me, the time is slowly ticking away~
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，你和我聊天的時候，時間可在一分一秒地流逝哦～
